lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of the circular blobs, forming a distinct rectangular lattice across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from illuminated dorsal surface to shadowed lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface, likely commensal organisms.
